name: Indiana Institute of Technology
academic_ranking: Private career-focused university in Fort Wayne, IN, organized into three colleges: College of Arts and Sciences, College of Business, and the Talwar College of Engineering and Computer Sciences. Known for industry-aligned, workforce-focused programs from certificates through doctoral degrees.
financial_aid: 2026-2027 traditional undergraduate tuition is $32,872/year (12-18 credits) plus a $560/year student services fee; part-time is $990/credit hour. Program-specific fees may apply (e.g., ~$2,106/year for Engineering/Computer/Other Sciences). School advertises up to $15,000 in merit scholarships with additional scholarship and aid programs available; net price calculators offered for freshmen and transfers.
facilities_notes: Indiana Tech Warriors softball competes at the NAIA level. No specific softball facility details were listed on the pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the Wolverine-Hoosier Athletic Conference (WHAC). Roster of 37 players for 2026.
notes: Data sourced from indianatechwarriors.com softball coaches and roster pages and indianatech.edu financial services pages, checked 2026-07. Roster size (37) counted from listed players on the softball roster page. Scholarship count not publicly listed. Team general X/Twitter account is @INTechSoftball; no individual coach handles listed. Non-coaching support staff on the staff page (Chris Reff, Assistant Athletic Trainer; Mackenna Warren, Student Manager) were excluded from the coaches list.
